description: This file contains functions and types related to managing group session keys, including resolving legacy session keys, normalizing labels, shortening IDs, building display names, and resolving session keys based on message context.

classes.name: LegacyGroupSessionSurface
classes.description: Type defining an object that may contain a method to resolve legacy group session keys.

methods.name: resolveLegacyGroupSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a legacy group session key using surfaces that may implement the resolveLegacyGroupSessionKey method.

methods.name: normalizeGroupLabel
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a hyphenated slug format.

methods.name: shortenGroupId
methods.description: Shortens a group ID string to a maximum of 14 characters, adding ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: buildGroupDisplayName
methods.description: Constructs a display name for a group based on provided parameters such as provider, subject, channel, space, id, and key.

methods.name: resolveGroupSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves a group session key from message context, considering legacy resolution, chat type, and provider hints.
